name: Seeing AI
description: A free app that narrates the world around you using AI. Designed for the blind and low vision community.
one_liner: A powerful accessibility app, but every photo you take is sent to Microsoft's cloud for AI analysis.

name: Live Transcribe
description: Live captioning for d/Deaf and hard of hearing in 145+ languages. Built for simplicity and ease of use.
one_liner: A genuinely useful accessibility app, but it serves ads and shares some data with advertisers and third-party vendors.

name: WordBoard: Text Expander
description: A custom iOS keyboard that lets you save and instantly insert text snippets, phrases, templates, images, and GIFs while typing in any app.
one_liner: A keyboard app with strong on-device privacy promises, but its privacy policy is extremely minimal and contradicts the app description in places.

name: Wondergrade: Learning Emotions
description: An interactive early childhood education app for children ages 3-8 that blends read-alouds, games, and audio stories with emotional learning.
one_liner: A well-designed emotions-learning app for young children, but its privacy policy contradicts the app's target audience and admits to selling user data.

name: Braille Academy: Play & Learn
description: An educational app that teaches Unified English Braille through 59 levels and 29 challenges. Works completely offline.
one_liner: A clean, ad-free Braille learning app that mostly works offline, but collects some device data through Firebase analytics.

name: Wingo - Daily Planner for Kids
developer: DREAM ORIENTED YAZILIM VE BILISIM LIMITED SIRKETI
description: A simplified daily calendar and visual planner app designed for kids, especially children with special needs and developmental disorders.
one_liner: A helpful planner app for children with special needs that mostly keeps data on-device, but its privacy policy is a generic website template with contradictions.

name: Mimi Hearing Test
description: A hearing assessment app that tests a wide range of frequencies in about 5 minutes, delivers instant results, and syncs with Apple Health.
one_liner: A popular and well-designed hearing test app, but its privacy policy is website-focused and completely silent on how your hearing data is handled.

name: 7 Minute Workout
description: Popular HIIT workout app with bodyweight exercises, workout tracking, and Apple HealthKit integration.
one_liner: A simple workout app that collects location and device data, integrates with HealthKit, but promises not to sell your health data to advertisers or data brokers.

name: adidas: Shop Shoes & Clothing
description: Shop adidas shoes, clothing, and accessories. Browse collections, get personalized recommendations, try on products with AR, and track orders.
one_liner: Heavy tracking and data sharing for advertising, with background location access and extensive profiling.

name: Aisle - Indian Dating App
description: An Indian dating app designed for meaningful relationships, connecting like-minded people looking for love.
one_liner: Aisle does not sell your data and keeps chats confidential, but your photos may be analyzed by an external face recognition tool and your profile is visible to all users.

name: AJIO Online Shopping App
description: AJIO is an online fashion and lifestyle shopping app offering clothing, footwear, accessories, and home products for men, women, and kids.
one_liner: A popular shopping app that aggressively tracks your behavior and shares your data widely across the Reliance ecosystem and with advertisers.

name: AllTrails: Hike, Bike & Run
description: Trail maps and outdoor navigation app with millions of hiking, biking, and running routes worldwide.
one_liner: Great for finding trails, but your profile, location, and activity data are public by default and shared with advertisers.

name: Amazon India Shop, Pay, miniTV
description: India's leading shopping app for products, payments, and streaming, offering a vast marketplace with fast delivery and integrated entertainment.
one_liner: Amazon India collects extensive data including your contacts, browsing habits, and health information for pharmacy services, but explicitly states it does not sell your personal information.

name: Asana Rebel: Get in Shape
description: A yoga and fitness app offering personalized workout plans, yoga routines, and fitness tracking to help users get in shape.
one_liner: A yoga and fitness app that tracks your workouts extensively and shares your data with a wide network of advertising and analytics partners.

name: Bazaart AI Photo Editor Design
description: An AI-powered photo and video editing app for designing graphics, removing backgrounds, and creating collages.
one_liner: Bazaart shares your data with numerous third-party tracking and AI services, and your photos may be processed on external servers, but you can use the app without signing up and request data deletion.

name: Blinkit: Groceries & more
description: A quick-commerce grocery delivery app promising instant delivery of groceries, fresh produce, and household essentials across Indian cities.
one_liner: Blinkit delivers groceries fast but tracks your device, checks what other apps you have, may record communications with delivery partners, and shares your data widely across the Zomato group.

name: BookMyShow | Movies & Events
description: India's largest online ticketing platform for movies, events, plays, sports, and activities.
one_liner: BookMyShow's privacy policy has not been updated since 2020 and states that your data may be shared with advertising networks and social media platforms.

name: Bumble
description: A dating and social networking app where women make the first move, offering modes for dating, friendship, and professional networking.
one_liner: Bumble collects extensive personal data including optional biometrics, reviews message content, shares data with advertisers, and makes your general location visible to other members.

name: Calm
description: A meditation, sleep, and relaxation app offering guided sessions, sleep stories, and mindfulness exercises.
one_liner: A meditation app that collects your sleep habits and mood data, then uses your personal information to show you targeted ads across the web.

name: Canva
description: An all-in-one design platform for creating social media graphics, presentations, posters, videos, and more with AI-powered tools.
one_liner: Canva collects extensive personal data including your designs and location, uses your content for AI training, and public posts may be indexed by search engines.

name: Canva: AI Video & Photo Editor
description: A design and editing platform for creating graphics, videos, photos, presentations, and documents with AI-powered tools.
one_liner: Canva is a powerful design app, but it shares lots of your data with advertisers and uses your uploads to train AI.

name: ChatGPT
description: An AI-powered assistant for writing, analysis, coding, creative projects, and learning, built by OpenAI.
one_liner: ChatGPT may use your conversations and publicly available internet data to train AI models unless you opt out, but you can delete chats and use Temporary Chat.

name: Cleanup: Phone Storage Cleaner
description: A phone storage cleaner utility that helps remove duplicate photos, compress videos, merge duplicate contacts, and clean spam emails to free up iPhone storage.
one_liner: Cleanup processes your photos on-device, but aggressively shares device and advertising data with multiple ad partners for personalized tracking.

name: Craft: Notes, Documents, AI
description: An all-in-one space for writing, collaborating, and getting organized with notes, documents, and AI assistance.
one_liner: Craft makes strong privacy promises: no ads, no data selling, and users keep control over their content.

name: Crunchyroll
description: The world's largest anime streaming platform, offering a vast library of anime, manga, and Asian dramas.
one_liner: Collects extensive usage data and shares it with third parties for advertising and analytics.

name: cult.fit Gym Workout & Fitness
description: India's leading fitness app offering gym workouts, yoga, meditation, sports nutrition, and mental health coaching with both online and in-center experiences.
one_liner: Cult.fit collects extensive health and biometric data including medical history and vaccination status, uses your camera for live workout tracking, accesses your address book, and shares data with affiliates and third parties with your consent.

name: Daily Yoga: Fit & Lazy Yoga®
developer: Xi'an Pengxiang Chuangda Technology Co., Ltd
description: A comprehensive yoga app offering guided classes, community features, and fitness tracking for all skill levels with both energetic and relaxing routines.
one_liner: Daily Yoga does not sell your personal data today and offers in-app deletion, but it reserves the right to sell data in the future and uses third-party ad trackers.

name: Dancebit: Home Dance Workouts
description: A dance-based home workout app offering personalized routines, AI-powered dance tutorials, and progress tracking.
one_liner: A dance workout app that collects your health data and body movement information, then shares it with a vast network of advertisers and analytics companies.

name: Decathlon Online Shopping App
description: India's leading sports retailer app offering equipment, apparel, and accessories for over 70 sports with in-store and online shopping features.
one_liner: Decathlon India collects standard shopping data but tracks your location even when the app is closed, shares data with affiliates, and may transfer it in a merger or acquisition.

name: Discord – Talk, Play, Hang Out
description: A voice, video, and text chat app designed for communities, gamers, and friends.
one_liner: States it does not sell your data, offers e2e calls and privacy controls, but receives outside behavioral data.

name: District: Movies Events Dining
description: An events, dining, and entertainment booking app by Zomato.
one_liner: Collects extensive personal data, shares across Eternal group, tracks precise location, and checks other installed apps.

name: Dropbox
description: A cloud storage and file synchronization service that lets you store, share, and access your files from anywhere.
one_liner: Dropbox states it does not sell your data to advertisers and gives you solid controls to access and delete your data.

name: Duolingo: Language Lessons
description: The world's most-downloaded education app for learning 40+ languages through quick, bite-sized lessons.
one_liner: Duolingo collects data about your learning activity and may show you personalized ads, but gives you real privacy controls and protects children far better than most apps.

name: EF Hello: Learn English
description: An English language learning app offering personalized courses, interactive lessons, and progress tracking to help users improve their English skills.
one_liner: EF Hello collects extensive personal data and shares it broadly with advertising platforms and affiliates for marketing, but it does provide user rights and claims it does not sell your data.

name: ELSA Speak - English Learning
description: AI-powered English pronunciation coach that analyzes your voice to help you improve speaking skills.
one_liner: English pronunciation coach that records your voice but also tracks you for ads and shares data widely.

name: F1 TV
description: Official Formula 1 streaming app for live races, highlights, and exclusive F1 content.
one_liner: F1 TV collects viewing and payment data, may share it across the F1 group and with advertising partners, but offers GDPR rights and opt-outs.

name: Finch: Self-Care Pet
description: A self-care app where you raise a digital pet to build healthy mental health habits.
one_liner: A mental health pet app with strong encryption options, but it tracks you for ads and stores sensitive reflections on company servers by default.

name: Fitbod Workout & Gym Planner
description: A gym workout planner that creates personalized strength-training routines based on your goals and available equipment.
one_liner: A popular workout planner that stores your sensitive fitness data on its servers and aggressively tracks your device for personalized advertising.

name: Flipkart - Online Shopping App
description: India's largest online marketplace for electronics, fashion, home essentials and more, offering fast delivery, easy returns, and secure payments.
one_liner: Flipkart collects extensive personal data including government IDs and financial details, shares it broadly across its corporate group and with advertisers, and uses it for behavioural profiling and targeted marketing.

name: Freeletics: Workouts & Fitness
description: Europe's #1 fitness app offering personalized HIIT, bodyweight, and gym workouts with an AI Coach.
one_liner: A polished fitness app with strong GDPR compliance and explicit health-data consent, but heavy ad-tracking integrations with Google, Meta, TikTok, and others drag the score down.

name: Gmail - Email by Google
description: Google's official email app with smart inbox organisation, spam filtering, and integration with Google Workspace.
one_liner: Gmail is a powerful email service, but Google's automated systems analyze your emails for security and may use your activity across Google services to personalize ads.

name: Goodnotes: AI Notes, Docs, PDF
description: Goodnotes is an AI-powered note-taking and PDF annotation app that lets you handwrite, type, record audio, and collaborate on documents across devices.
one_liner: Strong privacy promises for your notes, but extensive third-party sharing and ad tracking are concerning.

name: Google Drive — online backup
description: Google Drive lets you securely store, organise and collaborate on files and folders from anywhere, on any device. Part of Google Workspace with 15GB of free storage.
one_liner: Google scans your files for abuse but promises not to use them for ads.

name: Google Gemini
description: Google's AI assistant that helps with writing, planning, learning, and more using generative AI.
one_liner: Gemini saves your chats, may review them with humans, and shares data with Connected Apps.

name: Google Maps
description: Real-time GPS navigation, traffic, transit, and local exploration with Street View and reviews.
one_liner: Google Maps tracks your precise location when you use it and uses it for targeted ads.

name: Google Pay: Save, Pay, Manage
description: A simple and secure way to pay in stores, apps, and online, send money to friends, and manage your finances.
one_liner: Google stores your payment info and may use purchase activity for personalized ads.

name: Google Photos: Backup & Edit
description: Google Photos backs up your photos and videos to the cloud, uses AI to organize and search them, and offers editing tools. Part of Google services.
one_liner: Google analyzes your uploaded photos and videos, but does not use them for personalized ads.

name: Grammarly: AI Keyboard & Notes
description: Grammarly's AI-powered keyboard and notes app helps you write clearly and correctly across all your apps and documents.
one_liner: Useful writing tools, but extensive tracking and AI training on your content warrant careful consideration.

name: Gymverse: Gym Workout Planner
description: A gym workout planner app with guided routines and exercise tracking.
one_liner: A workout planner whose friendly 'human-readable' privacy policy dramatically understates the device tracking and ad profiling that actually happens behind the scenes.

name: H&M
description: Explore the latest styles in fashion, home and beauty with the H&M app. Discover inspiring collections and intuitive features that simplify the shopping experience — from instant search to real-time order updates.
one_liner: H&M shares your shopping behaviour and device identifiers with advertising partners for cross-app tracking, but offers opt-out controls and a privacy portal for managing your data.

name: happn: dating app
description: A location-based dating app that helps you find people you've crossed paths with in real life.
one_liner: Happn tracks your location regularly and shares your contact info with social networks for marketing.

name: Headway: Fun & Easy Growth
description: A daily micro-learning app offering 15-minute book summaries, audio learning, and personalized reading goals to help users grow through bite-sized content.
one_liner: Headway tracks reading habits and shares data with over 20 advertising partners.

name: Healthify: AI Calorie Tracker
description: AI-powered calorie tracker and nutrition app that helps users track meals, monitor health metrics, and receive personalized diet and fitness recommendations.
one_liner: HealthifyMe collects extensive health data including genetics and sexual orientation, processes your food photos through AI, shares data with third-party AI providers, and records your customer service calls stored on AWS.

name: Hinge
description: A dating app designed to be deleted, focused on fostering serious relationships through detailed profiles and conversation prompts.
one_liner: Hinge collects extremely sensitive personal data including your sexual orientation, health info, racial background, and face geometry, and shares some data with advertisers and vendors.

name: IKEA
description: Furniture and home goods shopping app with store locator, loyalty rewards, and in-store features.
one_liner: A major retailer that collects extensive shopping and browsing data for personalization and shares it across its corporate group and advertising partners.

name: InShot - AI Video Editor
description: A popular video and photo editing app with AI-powered features, filters, effects, and tools for creating social media content.
one_liner: InShot keeps photos on device and needs no account, but policy is silent on location.

name: Instagram
description: A free photo and video sharing app from Meta with feeds, Stories, Reels, and direct messaging, used by over 2 billion people worldwide.
one_liner: Collects extensive activity data and shares it across Meta Companies for advertising.

name: JioHotstar
description: India's leading streaming platform for live sports, movies, TV shows, and exclusive Hotstar Specials.
one_liner: Extensive data collection for ads and sharing with partners, though some opt-out controls exist.

name: JioSaavn – Music & Podcasts
description: India's leading music streaming app with 80 million songs, podcasts, and exclusive content across multiple languages.
one_liner: Extensive tracking and ad targeting across devices, with long-term data retention and broad third-party sharing.

name: KIC Wellness
description: KIC unites movement, mindset and rituals to help you build confidence, find calm, and move through life with purpose. Features guided meditations, expert-led fitness programs, dietitian-approved recipes, and pregnancy support.
one_liner: KIC Wellness collects sensitive health data, uses background location tracking, and shares your purchases and usage data for cross-app tracking, but pledges not to use AI inputs to train models and provides deletion rights.

name: LADDER Strength Training Plans
description: Personalized strength training app that pairs you with a certified coach to create custom workout programs, offer nutrition guidance, and track your fitness progress.
one_liner: Ladder collects extensive workout and health data, tracks your browsing behavior down to mouse movements and keystrokes, and shares data with advertising networks for targeted ads, but provides detailed opt-out controls.

name: Lenskart: Eyewear
description: Eyeglasses, sunglasses, and contact lenses shopping app with virtual 3D try-on features.
one_liner: Collects facial scans, prescription details, and tracks your device for ads.

name: Lightroom: AI Photo Editor
description: A professional photo and video editing app with cloud sync, AI-powered features, and advanced editing tools from Adobe.
one_liner: Powerful photo editor that analyzes your content using AI, with extensive data sharing and 10-year retention for business records.

name: LinkedIn
description: A professional networking platform for connecting with colleagues, finding jobs, sharing industry news, and building your career.
one_liner: LinkedIn shares your data with Microsoft for ads, trains AI models on your content, and tracks you across devices.

name: Meesho: Online Shopping
description: Meesho is an Indian online shopping app for fashion, home, and electronics, allowing users to buy products and also resell them to their network.
one_liner: Meesho collects extensive personal data including government IDs and device contacts, then shares it broadly with advertisers and affiliates.

name: Microsoft Bing Search
description: Microsoft Bing delivers fast, intelligently curated answers with AI-powered Copilot Search. Features include visual search, voice search, image creator, and Microsoft Rewards.
one_liner: A powerful search app with extensive data collection and AI training practices that warrant careful consideration.

name: Microsoft Copilot
description: Microsoft Copilot is an AI-powered assistant that helps you search the web, create text and images, and get answers using generative AI.
one_liner: Microsoft Copilot collects extensive data and may use your conversations to train AI models unless you opt out, while sharing behavioral data with a wide network of advertisers.

name: Microsoft Word
description: The mobile version of Microsoft's word-processing app for creating, editing, and sharing documents, with cloud sync via OneDrive and AI-powered Copilot features.
one_liner: Word processes documents on Microsoft cloud servers, tracks you across devices, and may use your data to train AI models unless you opt out.

name: MindNode - Mind Map & Outline
description: A mind mapping and outlining app for iOS that helps you visualize ideas and organize thoughts.
one_liner: MindNode is a privacy-conscious mind mapping app with end-to-end encrypted collaboration and strong GDPR compliance, though it collects device identifiers and shares data with named service providers.

name: Muscle Monster Workout Planner
description: A workout planner app that helps users schedule practice sessions, track progress, and set body improvement goals.
one_liner: Collects workout and health data plus your Facebook ID, but promises never to sell your information.

name: MyFitnessPal: Calorie Counter
description: Track calories, log meals, monitor macros, and connect fitness devices to reach your health and weight goals.
one_liner: MyFitnessPal collects extensive health and dietary data, tracks you across devices for ads, and shares information with advertising and research partners.

name: Myntra - Fashion Shopping App
description: India's leading fashion and lifestyle shopping app for clothing, footwear, accessories and home furnishing for men, women and kids.
one_liner: Myntra's privacy policy is inaccessible, but their Terms of Use reveals broad content rights, data sharing with sellers, and PAN card collection for large purchases.

name: Myntra - Fashion Shopping App
description: Fashion and lifestyle shopping app for clothing, footwear, and accessories.
one_liner: A major fashion shopping app with a sparse privacy policy that raises more questions than it answers.

name: Nike Run Club: Running Coach
description: Popular running app with GPS tracking, guided runs, training plans, and social features to help runners of all levels achieve their goals.
one_liner: Nike Run Club collects extensive workout and health data including GPS, heart rate, and body measurements, shares data with advertising partners using your email and phone, and transfers data internationally, but offers strong privacy controls and deletes inactive accounts after five years.

name: Notion: Notes, Tasks, AI
description: An all-in-one workspace for notes, tasks, wikis, and databases with built-in AI features for writing, summarizing, and organizing content.
one_liner: Notion gives you decent control over your data and lets you opt out of targeted ads, but it tracks you across devices, shares identifiers with advertisers, and your information could be transferred in a corporate sale.

name: Nykaa – Makeup/Beauty Shopping
description: A beauty and personal care e-commerce app that sells cosmetics, skincare, haircare, fragrances, and wellness products.
one_liner: Heavy data collection and ad tracking with broad third-party sharing.

name: Nykaa Fashion - Shopping App
description: Indian fashion and lifestyle e-commerce app for clothing, accessories, and beauty products.
one_liner: A popular Indian fashion shopping app that collects extensive personal data and shares it widely for advertising and logistics.

name: Pepperfry Furniture Store
description: Indian online marketplace for furniture, home decor, and furnishings with delivery tracking and payment integration.
one_liner: Popular furniture shopping app that shares your data widely with affiliates and tracks you for marketing, but never handles your payment details directly.

name: Perplexity - AI Search & Chat
description: AI-powered search and chat that delivers direct answers with cited sources.
one_liner: AI search that automatically collects usage data and shares it with advertising partners and data enrichment companies.

name: Photoroom: AI Photo Editor
description: AI-powered photo editing tool for creating and editing images, including background removal, batch processing, and e-commerce integration.
one_liner: AI photo editor that uses your uploaded images to train its models, but offers an opt-out and does not sell your data.

name: Picsart AI Photo Editor, Video
description: A popular AI-powered photo and video editing app with creative tools, templates, filters, and a social community for sharing creations.
one_liner: Heavy ad tracking and broad data sharing overshadow strong protections for biometric data.

name: Pinterest: Lifestyle Ideas
description: Visual discovery and bookmarking platform for lifestyle ideas, DIY projects, recipes, fashion, home decor, and creative inspiration.
one_liner: Pinterest tracks your activity on and off the platform to show you personalized ads, shares data with Facebook and Google, and uses your content to train AI models.

name: Procreate Dreams
description: Animation and creative storytelling app with zero data collection.
one_liner: A rare privacy-perfect app that collects no data and requires no account.

name: PUMA | Shop Clothes & Trainers
description: Shop the latest PUMA clothes, trainers, and accessories with personalised recommendations, virtual try-on, and exclusive app-only offers.
one_liner: PUMA collects shopping and device data for personalisation and ads, shares it with retargeting partners, and uses fingerprinting—though it offers better data rights than many shopping apps.

name: Push Up Counter - 100 Pushups
description: Push-up counter and trainer app that uses your device's camera to track reps and guide you to 100 push-ups.
one_liner: A simple push-up counter with excellent on-device privacy for camera and health data, but ad trackers follow you around the web.

name: PURE: Open-Minded Dating App
description: An open-minded dating app designed for casual connections and hookups, with photo verification and safety features.
one_liner: Collects sensitive sexual orientation and biometric data, shares data globally with service providers, and states that staff may manually review your chat messages.

name: Rapido: Bike-Taxi, Auto & Cabs
description: Bike-taxi, auto and cab ride-hailing service in India.
one_liner: Collects extensive location, identity, and device data, but explicitly avoids targeted advertising.

name: Remini - AI Photo Enhancer
description: An AI-powered photo and video enhancement app that improves resolution, colors, and quality, and generates new AI portraits from your photos.
one_liner: Remini enhances your photos with AI, but uploads your images and face data to servers, tracks your activity for ads, and shares data with third-party AI providers.

name: Runna: Running Plans & Coach
description: A running app offering personalized training plans, GPS tracking, and coaching features for runners of all levels.
one_liner: A well-structured running app with strong privacy rights and explicit health data protections, but broad third-party sharing and targeted advertising keep it from a top score.

name: Seven: 7 Minute Workout
description: Quick 7-minute HIIT workout app with personalized plans, progress tracking, and social features.
one_liner: Collects health and workout data with your consent, but shares usage information with third parties for cross-service promotion.

name: Shaadi.com Matrimony App
description: The world's largest matrimonial service and one of India's best known brands, helping people find life partners since 1996.
one_liner: Shaadi.com collects identity proofs and financial data, then shares your profile with other users.

name: SHEIN India Fast Fashion
description: Indian fast fashion shopping app offering clothing, accessories, and lifestyle products for women and men.
one_liner: A fast fashion shopping app that collects extensive personal and financial data, tracks your location and behavior, and shares it with affiliates and third-party service providers.

name: Sleep Cycle - Tracker & Sounds
description: Popular sleep tracker that uses sound analysis and accelerometer data to monitor sleep patterns, snoring, and wake you gently.
one_liner: A privacy-respecting sleep tracker that keeps health data local by default, but still collects sensitive sleep information and uses your microphone overnight.

name: SmartGym: Gym & Home Workouts
description: A gym and home workout tracker that lets you log routines, track progress, and optionally sync data across devices.
one_liner: A refreshingly privacy-respecting workout tracker that lets you keep all data on-device and promises never to sell or share your information.

name: Snapchat
description: A multimedia messaging app known for ephemeral photos and videos, creative filters, and location-based features like Snap Map.
one_liner: Heavy data collection for ads and personalization; chats auto-delete but shadow profiles exist from contacts.

name: Sololearn: Learn to Code
description: Learn to code with bite-sized lessons in Python, JavaScript, C++, and more. Includes an AI chatbot (Kodie) and interactive coding playground.
one_liner: A solid coding app, but it shares data with advertisers and tracks your activity across websites.

name: StepsApp Pedometer
description: A step counter and activity tracker with social features including leaderboards, challenges, and GPS workout tracking.
one_liner: Collects extensive health data and shares it with advertisers and AI companies for insights and ad targeting.

name: Strava: Run, Bike, Walk
description: Popular social fitness network for runners, cyclists, and walkers to track activities, share routes, compete on segments, and connect with a global athletic community.
one_liner: Strava makes your profile and activities publicly visible by default, tracks your precise GPS location for core features, and uses your data to train AI models, but offers robust privacy controls and does not sell health data for ads.

name: Structured: Daily Planner Todo
description: A daily planner and todo app that simplifies task and event planning with optional cloud sync and AI assistance.
one_liner: A privacy-conscious planner with strong GDPR rights, but data goes to multiple US processors and the policy leaves many app permissions unexplained.

name: Sweat: Fitness App For Women
developer: The Bikini Body Training Company Pty Ltd
description: Sweat is a fitness app for women offering workout programs, training, and community features.
one_liner: A popular fitness app with strong user rights and transparent GDPR compliance, but heavy ad tracking and broad third-party data sharing raise real concerns.

name: Swiggy: Food Instamart Dineout
description: Food delivery, grocery, and restaurant platform in India.
one_liner: Extensive data sharing, mandatory ads, and deep device tracking make this a poor privacy choice.

name: Tata CLiQ Luxury Shopping App
description: Luxury fashion and lifestyle shopping app by Tata Unistore.
one_liner: Collects government IDs and biometric data, then shares it across the Tata Group for profiling and marketing.

name: Telegram Messenger
description: Pure instant messaging — simple, fast, secure, and synced across all your devices. One of the top 5 most downloaded apps in the world with over 1 billion active users.
one_liner: A privacy-focused messaging app that doesn't show ads, but uploads your contacts to its servers.

name: TeraBox: 1TB Cloud & AI Space
description: A cloud storage app offering up to 1TB of free space for files, photos, and videos, with AI-powered features for photo categorization and audio transcription.
one_liner: TeraBox states that it scans your uploaded photos with AI, sends audio to Google for transcription, and may build behavioral profiles for automated marketing.

name: Tiimo: To-Do List & AI Planner
description: A visual planning and productivity app with to-do lists, focus timers, AI-powered planning, and wellbeing tracking. Designed for individuals with ADHD and autism.
one_liner: A GDPR-compliant planner that doesn't sell your data, but uses marketing trackers and keeps your info for two years after you leave.

name: TikTok
description: A short-form video platform for creating, sharing, and discovering content, with live streaming, shopping features, and personalized recommendations.
one_liner: Extensive data collection including keystroke patterns and face analysis, with broad sharing across advertising networks.

name: Tinder Dating App: Date & Chat
description: The world's most popular dating app for meeting new people, with millions of users nearby and around the globe.
one_liner: Tinder may collect your face geometry, government ID, and sensitive profile details, and states that it shares your data with Match Group affiliates and advertising partners.

name: Tira: Online Beauty Shopping
description: An e-commerce app for beauty and personal care products by Reliance Retail.
one_liner: A beauty shopping app that collects standard e-commerce data but shares it widely with advertisers and third parties.

name: Truecaller: Premium Caller ID
description: Caller ID and spam blocking app with global phone number lookup.
one_liner: Truecaller collects extensive device and usage data, including your location, call logs, installed apps, and advertising ID, and shares it with third parties for targeted ads.

name: Uber - Request a Ride
description: Request a ride, order food delivery, and get where you need to go.
one_liner: A ride and delivery app that collects vast amounts of personal data and shares it widely with advertisers and partners.

name: UNIQLO India: Clothing Store
description: Japanese fashion retailer's India app offering minimalist, high-quality everyday clothing for men, women, and kids with in-store and online shopping features.
one_liner: UNIQLO India collects standard shopping data and uses cookies for personalized ads, but explicitly states it does not sell your personal information and limits sharing to affiliates and service providers.

name: Urban Ladder
developer: Urban Ladder Home Decor Solutions Private Limited
description: India's leading furniture and home decor shopping app offering sofas, beds, dining sets, lighting, and more with in-store and online shopping features.
one_liner: Urban Ladder records your audio and video calls, may transfer your data in a corporate sale, and tracks your browsing patterns, but does not use personal information to target advertisements.

name: Viki: Asian Dramas, Movies, TV
description: A streaming service for Asian dramas, movies, and TV shows with community subtitles and personalized recommendations.
one_liner: Viki tracks everything you watch and shares your data with Rakuten and ad networks, but gives you real opt-out tools for targeted ads.

name: Walkr - Gamified Fitness Walk
description: Gamified fitness walking app that turns daily steps into a space exploration adventure.
one_liner: A fun walking game that tracks your fitness data and shows targeted ads, though health data is kept out of ad targeting.

name: Westside
description: Westside is a one-stop fashion destination for women, men, and kids, offering clothing, footwear, accessories, beauty, and home decor with easy browsing and quick checkout.
one_liner: Westside shares your shopping behaviour and personal data with the Tata Group and advertising partners for personalised ads, but explicitly commits to not selling your data and offers strong DPDP Act rights.

name: WhatsApp Messenger
description: A free, end-to-end encrypted messaging and calling app used by over 2 billion people worldwide, owned by Meta.
one_liner: Your messages are encrypted, but WhatsApp shares your contacts and activity data with Meta Companies.

name: Workout for Women: Fit at Home
description: Tone your body and lose weight with the #1 home workout for women. Quick and effective 7-minute bodyweight workouts with animation and video guidance, music, and Apple Health sync.
one_liner: This workout app tracks you across other apps for advertising, shares your data with Google and Facebook for remarketing, and collects detailed health data including menstrual cycle and sexual activity.

name: Yoga Fit | Yoga for Beginners
description: Start your yoga and meditation journey with beginner-friendly routines.
one_liner: Collects health and optional face photos, but shares email and device ID with marketing partners.

name: Yoga for beginners | Prayoga
description: A yoga app for beginners that uses on-device body tracking technology to give real-time feedback as you perform asanas and poses.
one_liner: Prayoga does not sell your data and offers a 30-day retention limit, but it allows third-party advertisers to track your app activity with cookies and may transfer your data in a business sale.

name: Yoga for Beginners, Pilates+
description: A yoga and pilates workout app for beginners with guided routines.
one_liner: A basic yoga app that claims not to collect personal data, but its short, copy-pasted privacy policy leaves many important questions unanswered.

name: YogiFi: Smart Yoga Trainer
description: YogiFi is your personal yoga trainer on the go, offering curated stretching, breathing, and meditation content by expert trainers. When paired with the YogiFi smart yoga mat, it measures your progress and provides real-time posture feedback. Integrates with Apple Watch and Apple HealthKit.
one_liner: YogiFi collects health and fitness data including heart rate and pose data, but it is all kept unlinked to your identity, processed locally when possible, and never used for cross-app tracking or ads.

name: YouTube
description: The world's largest video-sharing platform for watching, uploading, and discovering video content across all genres.
one_liner: Tracks every video you watch for personalized ads, but offers strong privacy controls to manage your data.

name: YouTube Music
description: Stream music, watch videos, and discover new artists.
one_liner: YouTube Music may use your activity across Google services to show personalized ads, with tools to manage your data.

name: ZARA
description: ZARA is a leading fashion retail app offering the latest clothing, accessories, and home collections for men, women, and kids with fast delivery and easy returns.
one_liner: ZARA collects standard shopping data but shares it widely with its parent company and third-party marketers, while tracking your behaviour across platforms.

name: Zomato: Food Delivery & Dining
description: Discover restaurants, read reviews, and order food for delivery or dining out.
one_liner: Zomato collects your location, device details, and usage activity, and may share data with affiliates and advertisers. Its policy says continued use automatically accepts future changes.

name: Zoom Workplace
description: A video-first unified communications platform offering video meetings, team chat, phone, whiteboard, and AI-powered features for workplace collaboration.
one_liner: Zoom is essential for video meetings, but it extensively collects device details, behavior, and meeting content — and your employer may have full access to everything you say or share.

name: Sago Mini First Words: Kids 1+
description: The best speech companion for kids. Sago Mini First Words is the most playful way to support your little one's speech development!
one_liner: A COPPA-certified kids' speech app that collects some child data and shares with many service providers, but offers strong local protections.

name: Proloquo
description: An intuitive Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) app designed for all ages. Features a large vocabulary, word prediction, and a unique Thinking Space mode for visual communication.
one_liner: A thoughtfully designed AAC app with strong privacy protections, explicit no-ads commitments, and excellent safeguards for children.

name: Speechify – Text to Speech PDF
description: Text to speech app that reads PDFs, docs, articles, and more aloud using AI voices.
one_liner: Solid privacy stance on selling data, but loads tracking pixels and stores your documents on its servers.

name: Be My Eyes
description: Connects blind and low-vision users with volunteers and AI for real-time visual assistance through video calls and photo descriptions.
one_liner: A well-meaning app with strong security, but your video calls may be shared with third parties for AI research.
